user_query: I need some inspiration for my next shower thought. Fetch me the top shower thought of all time from the stapi - showerthoughts API. Additionally, provide me with a random cat fact from the Meowfacts API.

TaskList.description: 查询‘showerthoughts’ API，获取历史上最受欢迎的‘shower thought’内容。
required_inputs: API功能：获取‘shower thought’的排行榜或最热门条目

TaskList.description: 查询‘Meowfacts’ API，获取一条随机的猫咪相关知识或趣闻。
required_inputs: API功能：获取随机猫咪趣闻

dependencies.description: 两个子任务可以同时执行，也可按顺序执行，互不依赖。
